hero.title: Why Study Nursing in Ireland?
hero.subtitle: Ireland offers world-class BSc (Hons) and MSc Nursing degrees accredited by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI), combining over 2,000 hours of clinical hospital placements with a 36-week paid final-year internship.

overview: Students interested in pursuing nursing in Ireland benefit from internationally recognized university degrees, strong clinical hospital partnerships, and direct registration pathways with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI).
Edu-Hawk Worldwide helps Indian students shortlist top Irish nursing schools, verify academic and IELTS requirements, prepare applications, and manage student visa documentation.
